item.title: Train strikes vehicle in La Cygne
item.description: On December 4th, 2024, at approximately 8:20 PM, La Cygne Emergency Personnel were dispatched to the railroad crossing at S. 4th St. and Elm St. for a reported collision between a train and a vehicle.Responders determined the vehicle was unoccupied at the time of impact and had become stuck on the tracks due to driver error.While the incident resulted in no injuries and just loss of property, it serves as an important reminder of railroad safety. item.title: Metz depot to be possible addition to Frontier Village in Adrian
item.description: As Frontier Village in Adrian already serves as a permanent home for several local historical structures, this may be next on the list as negotiations are ongoing to relocate the Metz railroad depot to the village.Plans are already in the works to rebuild what appears to be the last depot in the area and despite its appearance, it has "good bones" making it the perfect candidate.More information to be provided soon.

item.title: Obituary - Russell Glen "Rusty" Moore
item.description: Russell Glen "Rusty" Moore, age 69, La Cygne, Kansas passed away Tuesday, December 2, 2025. He was born on June 19, 1956 in Butler, Missouri the son of Loy and Anna Lee Moore. He graduated from Prairie View High School in the Class of 1974. He was very active in FFA. He was a farmer and was a talented welder.
